title: Lianhua

{{NPC Infobox |image=NPC.png |type=Open-World |nation=Huanglong |location=Xuanfang Hold |affiliation=Ministry of Development |group= }} '''Lianhua''' is an NPC artisan seen at Xuanfang Hold [[Resonance Nexus|Lexicon Axis]], checking on a Rafter Kite. __NOTOC__ ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Lianhua:''' Good, it's not broken... Just a jammed drive shaft. :'''Lianhua:''' You know what? This Rafter Kite was commissioned by a couple from Jinzhou... :'''Lianhua:''' Said they wanted to have a full experience of Xuanfang's Rafter Kite love messages... :'''Lianhua:''' Whenever I was on duty these past few days, I'd catch them sketching together, snapping photos, or just leaning against each other on a bench... :'''Lianhua:''' The [[Wuli|young man]] told me the [[Fuling|girl]] used to be too sick to travel far. Now that she's recovering, she wants to hit every city in Huanglong. :'''Lianhua:''' Xuanfang is just a rest stop for them. Mengzhou City's next. :'''Lianhua:''' What a lovely couple... Hope the road treats them well. ===Interacting with the Rafter Kite=== ---- :{{Readable|Fuling,
I'm off to Huaxu Academy for your medicine. You looked so peaceful asleep this morning, so I couldn't bear to wake you. Please have a good breakfast when you're up. You're still recovering and can't afford to skip meals.
Xuanfang Hold has so many pavilions, towers, and little courtyards to explore. When I get back, we'll go sketching together.
—Wuli|title=Letter Sealed in a Rafter Kite}} {{Dialogue End}} ---- ==Trivia== * The Jinzhou couple he spoke of is [[Fuling]] and [[Wuli]], who can be found later after in Xuanfang Hold after completing {{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Lianhua |zhs = 廉桦 |zht = 廉樺 |ja = 廉樺（レンカ） |ko = 염화 |fr = Lianhua |de = Lianhua |es = Lianhua |th = Lianhua |pt = Lianhua }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.5}}
